accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibilityPage.description: Accessibility statement for the Pierres en Lumières website in accordance with RGAA 4.1.
accessibilityPage.intro: Pierres en Lumières is committed to making its website accessible in accordance with Article 47 of the French Law No. 2005-102 of 11 February 2005.
accessibilityPage.conformityText: This website is <bold>non-conformant</bold> with the General Reference for Digital Accessibility Improvement (RGAA), version 4.1. No conformity audit has been conducted yet.
accessibilityPage.nonAccessible1: Some externally sourced images may lack optimal text alternatives.
accessibilityPage.nonAccessible2: The interactive map (Mapbox) has limited accessibility for screen reader users.
accessibilityPage.feedbackText: If you are unable to access content or a service, you can contact the site administrator to be directed to an accessible alternative or to obtain the content in another format.
accessibilityPage.recourseText: If you encounter an accessibility problem preventing you from accessing content or a site feature, and you are unable to obtain a response from us, you have the right to file a complaint with the Defender of Rights (Défenseur des droits).
